_meta.fill_ordering: BINDING (Ember #6485): (1) epoch-lambda measured on the flown register at the submission window -> lambda_provenance; (2) THEN u_est, tau_Q, Q grids, noise-only curves derived FROM that lambda; (3) THEN submit. Pre-computing derived fields from an earlier lambda is a stale number wearing a frozen field — the grader's derived-from assertion (check_derived_from) recomputes lambda -> u_est -> tau_Q per rung and REFUSES on mismatch, so provenance is checked, not just presence.

Contract rests on: (a) API-surface enumeration — no client knob exists (Ember #6374/#6375); (b) declaration (Elder #6372); (c) STRUCTURAL: the PUB shape submits ONE parameterized ISA circuit + a binding table — per-branch structural divergence at the server would require PER-ROW recompilation, which contradicts the format's purpose (one compiled schedule, many bindings; rz binding is a frame update). NOT a documented guarantee, and labeled so.

staged_submission.continue_rule: COST-ONLY (measured per-shot QPU rate) — outcome-independent by construction; NO rung unsealed until the flight set is closed (card f1e8042)
staged_submission.pilot_u_consistency_probe: PRE-REGISTERED EMPIRICAL ARM of the no-retranspile declaration: the pilot's measured Q-arm accept statistics imply a delivered u; it must lie WITHIN CI of the epoch-lambda prediction exp(-lambda*N2q). A server-side deletion of angle-0 slots would INFLATE measured u above prediction in a branch-correlated way — anomalously GOOD fidelity is the signature, and it is grounds to HALT before the main submission, not to celebrate.
